propositions: Mapped project keys that are decommissioned or inaccessible to the bridge bot are not validated before reconcile mutations, causing failures deep in fan-out with opaque ACLI errors
resolve_project returns legacy_default unvalidated, allowing unbound/legacy tickets to create into wrong projects when legacy_default is invisible or incorrect

A preflight probe must validate all projects the reconcile pass could touch (mapped keys, legacy_default fallback, and configured query_project) are visible to the bot before any outbound mutation occurs
The preflight helper check_mapped_project_visibility is reusable for both reconciler passes and bridge fsck diagnostics, probing Jira Cloud via paginated GET /rest/api/3/project/search
Preflight must fail closed on auth/transport errors and distinguish transport unavailability from missing-project visibility, aborting the pass before reconcile_once with an actionable message
